purpose: Prospective public positioning evidence and actual-fill trend residual research
new_hypothesis_validation: Only unseen future dates; do not reuse earlier flow-v1 holdout as proof

collection.rate_limit_scope: existing LIVE host market lane; preserve management reserve
collection.failure_effect: research UNKNOWN or DEFERRED only; no execution dependency

interpretation.top_ratio: Relative subgroup shares; not absolute inventory or participant intent
interpretation.open_interest: Base quantity and notional value separately; never net capital inflow
interpretation.funding: Past settled rates and current quoted rate are separate, intervals may change
interpretation.availability: A historical event timestamp is not proof of receipt at that event time
interpretation.baseline: Keep price-only baseline and failed/unknown controls
interpretation.costs: Unknown counterfactual funding is not zero; gross shadow is not realizable net PnL
